title: The Sunday Read: ‘What Happened to Val Kilmer?’

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中漫步七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60个超级圣代。

sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最棒的球队。

sentences.en: I had been trying to write a Val Kilmer story for years and he would never say yes to it.
sentences.zh: 我多年来一直想写一篇关于方·基默的故事，但他从未答应过。

sentences.en: And finally he said yes.
sentences.zh: 最后他终于答应了。

sentences.en: I don't know why I was so lucky.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么我这么幸运。

sentences.en: To have him say yes at that moment.
sentences.zh: 能在那个时刻听到他答应。

sentences.en: But I know what he would say.
sentences.zh: 但我知道他会说什么。

sentences.en: I know that he would say that it wasn't luck.
sentences.zh: 我知道他会说这不是运气。

sentences.en: That it was my faith.
sentences.zh: 那是我的信念。

sentences.en: These people, you write about them.
sentences.zh: 这些人，你写过他们。

sentences.en: And you become associated with them forever.
sentences.zh: 然后你便与他们永远联系在了一起。

sentences.en: And you don't even know what a privilege that's going to be.
sentences.zh: 而你甚至不知道这将是一种多么大的特权。

sentences.en: Years and years later.
sentences.zh: 多年以后。

sentences.en: I'm Taffy Brodesser-Eckner.
sentences.zh: 我是塔菲·布罗德瑟-埃克纳。

sentences.en: And I'm a staff writer for the New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: The actor Val Kilmer died on Tuesday in Los Angeles at the age of 65.
sentences.zh: 演员方·基默周二在洛杉矶逝世，享年65岁。

sentences.en: And for the Sunday Read this week, we are once again airing the profile I wrote of Val in 2020 during a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 作为本周的“星期日阅读”，我们再次播客我在2020年疫情期间写的关于方的特写。

sentences.en: Everyone has a favorite Val Kilmer that feels very personal and specific to them in Top Gun, in Heat, in The Doors, in Batman Forever.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有一个最喜欢的方·基默，对他有着非常个人和具体的记忆：在《壮志凌云》中，在《盗火线》中，在《大门乐队》中，在《永远的蝙蝠侠》中。

sentences.en: He was the kind of actor who was always running from his good looks, even as he greatly benefited from them.
sentences.zh: 他是那种总是极力摆脱自己英俊外表，却又深受其益的演员。

sentences.en: I could not believe his jaw when I met him.
sentences.zh: 我见到他时，简直不敢相信他的下巴。

sentences.en: Same as I couldn't believe it in a movie theater when I was 12 years old.
sentences.zh: 就像我12岁时在电影院里看到时一样不敢相信。

sentences.en: In 2014, he was diagnosed with throat cancer, and he chose not to treat it medically, but through prayer and counseling on his faith.
sentences.zh: 2014年，他被诊断出喉癌，他选择不进行医学治疗，而是通过祈祷和信仰辅导。

sentences.en: He was a Christian scientiSt.
sentences.zh: 他是一位基督教科学派信徒。

sentences.en: Eventually, his children begged him to seek medical intervention, and he finally did.
sentences.zh: 最终，他的孩子们恳求他寻求医疗干预，他终于照做了。

sentences.en: And when I met him, he had had a tracheostomy.
sentences.zh: 当我见到他时，他已经做过气管切开手术。

sentences.en: He was speaking by covering up the hole in his throat, and he was still performing.
sentences.zh: 他靠捂住喉咙上的洞说话，并且他仍在表演。

sentences.en: What does somebody do when the thing that they are known for, which is being a superhero, which is being an action hero, which is being handsome,
sentences.zh: 当一个人以扮演超级英雄、动作英雄、英俊小生而闻名，

sentences.en: which is being this sort of picture of good health and vigor, what do you do next?
sentences.zh: 当这种健康和精力的化象不再时，接下来该怎么办？

sentences.en: And a lot of people, they fade away, but that's not how it went for Val.
sentences.zh: 很多人都渐渐淡出了，但方并不是这样。

sentences.en: All of the vocal exercises he'd learned at Juilliard had come in handy because he was able to figure out how to speak again in a way that he should not have been able to communicate,
sentences.zh: 他在茱莉亚学院学过的所有发声练习都派上了用场，因为他摸索出了一种本不应该能够交流的方式重新说话，

sentences.en: but he was.
sentences.zh: 但他做到了。

sentences.en: And the force of his will is the thing I remember about him.
sentences.zh: 他意志的力量是我对他的深刻记忆。

sentences.en: The force of his will, the fact that he was sure he was going to come back to his exact former self, and in some senses felt that he was, that he was all soul and all will.
sentences.zh: 他意志的力量，他坚信自己能完全恢复到从前的样子的信念，某种意义上也确实如此，他纯粹由灵魂和意志构成。

sentences.en: And very often throughout the pandemic, when I would feel despair, I would think that somewhere Val Kilmer is sitting with a hole in his throat, and he does not see despair.
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间的很多时候，当我感到绝望时，我会想，方·基默正坐在某处，喉咙上带着一个洞，而他并没有看到绝望。

sentences.en: He sees the opportunity for faith.
sentences.zh: 他看到的是信仰的机会。

sentences.en: And one of my best friends called me up and said that she had throat cancer.
sentences.zh: 我最好的朋友之一打电话给我，说她得了喉癌。

sentences.en: And I was with Val Kilmer the next day, and I said to him, my best friend has throat cancer.
sentences.zh: 第二天我和方·基默在一起，我对他说，我最好的朋友得了喉癌。

sentences.en: And he said, tell her she shouldn't worry.
sentences.zh: 他说，告诉她不用担心。

sentences.en: And I included this in the story.
sentences.zh: 我把这个写进了故事里。

sentences.en: And sometimes people still ask me about it.
sentences.zh: 有时人们仍然会向我问起这件事。

sentences.en: And people will ask once again, now that this story is going out into the world again.
sentences.zh: 随着这个故事再次问世，人们又会问起。

sentences.en: And I want to tell you all that Lydia is fine now.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉大家，莉迪亚现在很好。

sentences.en: And this morning, the first call I made was to her, to tell her that he had died.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我打出的第一个电话就是给她，告诉她他已经去世了。

sentences.en: And we were so sad together.
sentences.zh: 我们一起沉浸在悲伤中。

sentences.en: All I could think about is the fact that maybe I think about him more than anyone else I've ever written about.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里想的全部就是，也许我对他的惦念超过了我写过的任何人。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry he's gone.
sentences.zh: 得知他离去，我深感难过。

sentences.en: So here's my article, The Iceman in Winter, from the May 10th, 2020 issue of the New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 这是我的文章《冬日冰人》，选自2020年5月10日的《纽约时报杂志》。

sentences.en: And it's read by Julia Whalen.
sentences.zh: 由朱莉娅·惠伦朗读。

sentences.en: Our audio producer today is Jack Bizzidoro.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的音频制作人是杰克·比齐多罗。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: It's hard to believe now, as I write this, but just two months ago, when we were allowed to roam free,
sentences.zh: 现在写下这些时很难相信，就在两个月前，当我们还被允许自由出行时，

sentences.en: when we could board planes and delight from them and wander into rental cars and check into hotels,
sentences.zh: 当我们还能登上飞机并从中获得乐趣，走进租来的汽车，入住酒店时，

sentences.en: when we could chase down and replenish the beauty and wonder our very cells need to survive,
sentences.zh: 当我们还能追寻并补充我们细胞生存所需的美丽与惊奇时，

sentences.en: I went to Los Angeles, where I was asked this question by Val Kilmer.
sentences.zh: 我去了洛杉矶，方·基默向我提出了这样一个问题。

sentences.en: Do you think South by Southwest will be canceled?
sentences.zh: 你觉得西南偏南音乐节会取消吗？

sentences.en: But Val Kilmer no longer sounds like Val Kilmer, the movie star of the 80s and 90s who has mostly vanished from screens.
sentences.zh: 但方·基默听起来已不再像那个80和90年代的电影明星方·基默了，他大部分时间已从银幕上消失。

sentences.en: He hasn't since his tracheostomy.
sentences.zh: 自从做了气管切开手术后就一直是这样。

sentences.en: He can still squeeze air up through his windpipe, however, and passed the hole that was cut into his throat and the tracheostomy tube in a way that makes him somewhat understood.
sentences.zh: 不过，他仍然可以把空气从气管挤压上来，通过喉咙上切开的洞和气管套管发出声音，让人勉强听懂。

sentences.en: Not very, but somewhat.
sentences.zh: 不是非常清楚，但勉强能懂。

sentences.en: The sound is something between a squeak and a voiceless roar.
sentences.zh: 那声音介于尖叫和无声的咆哮之间。

sentences.en: He says the fact that I can understand him is a result of the endless vocal exercises that he was trained to do when he went to Juilliard after high school,
sentences.zh: 他说我能听懂他是因为高中毕业后在茱莉亚学院受过无休止的发声训练的结果，

sentences.en: that he was taught to work his voice like it was a trumpet.
sentences.zh: 他被教导把自己的声音当成小号一样去练习。

sentences.en: He hated the authoritarian rule at Juilliard while he was there.
sentences.zh: 他在茱莉亚学院读书时，曾讨厌那里的专制规则。

sentences.en: He hated those stupid vocal exercises.
sentences.zh: 他讨厌那些愚蠢的发声练习。

sentences.en: Now look at him, still using his most beloved instrument, when really, by all rights, it should be useless.
sentences.zh: 现在看看他，依然在使用他最钟爱的乐器，而按常理它本该毫无用处了。

sentences.en: See how it all turned out for the best?
sentences.zh: 看吧，事情是不是都往最好的方向发展了？

sentences.en: All Val Kilmer's stories are like that.
sentences.zh: 方·基默所有的故事都是这样的。

sentences.en: Told with that same dash of preordained kismet.
sentences.zh: 带着那种命中注定的缘分色彩讲述。

sentences.en: He was traveling in Africa in 1994 when he decided to spend a morning exploring a bat cave.
sentences.zh: 1994年他在非洲旅行时，决定花一个上午去探索一个蝙蝠洞。

sentences.en: Later that day, literally, seriously, that day, he was inspired to call his agent, who had been trying to contact Kilmer for weeks
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，千真万确，就是那天，他受到启发给他的经纪人打了电话，经纪人已经联系了基默几个星期，

sentences.en: to see if he was interested in playing the role of Batman now that Michael Keaton was hanging it up.
sentences.zh: 想看他在迈克尔·基顿不演之后是否有兴趣扮演蝙蝠侠。

sentences.en: Another story?
sentences.zh: 另一个故事？

sentences.en: In the days before he set eyes for the first time on his now ex-wife, Joanne Wally, he dreamed that he met the woman he was destined for
sentences.zh: 在他第一次见到现在的前妻乔安妮·威利之前的日子里，他梦见自己遇到了命中注定的那个女人，

sentences.en: and woke up and immediately wrote a poem called
sentences.zh: 醒来后立刻写了一首诗，

sentences.en: We've Just Met, But Marry Me, Please.
sentences.zh: 名叫《我们刚见面，但请嫁给我》。

sentences.en: Then, right after that, he went to London, and while he was there, he saw a play, and Wally was in it.
sentences.zh: 然后，紧接着，他去了伦敦，在那里他看了一场话剧，威利就在其中。

sentences.en: He was so taken with her that he followed her to the pub after party just so he could look at her.
sentences.zh: 他被她迷住了，以至于跟着她去了派对后的酒吧，只为了能看看她。

sentences.en: This was crazy even for him, so he made no move.
sentences.zh: 这对他来说都太疯狂了，所以他没有采取任何行动。

sentences.en: But two years later, in 1987, she would be randomly, coincidentally,
sentences.zh: 但两年后的1987年，她机缘巧合、阴差阳错地

sentences.en: serendipitously cast opposite him in Willow, and they would end up married.
sentences.zh: 被选中在《威洛比》中与他演对手戏，最终他们结为了夫妻。

sentences.en: So, yes, he can talk, and it's such a miracle that he has these abilities, because if you have enough faith, you'll see how every part of your life
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，他会说话，他拥有这些能力简直是个奇迹，因为如果你有足够的信念，你就会发现你生活中的每一部分

sentences.en: is just a piece of a bigger part of your life, and nothing is an accident, and everything is good.
sentences.zh: 都只是你人生宏大图景的一部分，一切都不是偶然，一切都是美好的。

sentences.en: We were in his office at Hellmel, an office space-slash-art gallery-slash-artist studio-slash-retail museum for Val Kilmer's movie career that takes up several storefronts
sentences.zh: 我们在他在海尔梅尔的办公室里，这是一个办公空间兼艺术画廊兼艺术家工作室兼方·基默电影生涯零售博物馆，占据了好莱坞埃奇蒙特街和天芥菜大道之间梅尔罗斯大街的几个店面

sentences.en: and more than half the block of Melrose Avenue between Edgemont Street and Heliotrope Drive in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 以及超过半个街区。

sentences.en: Officially, according to Brad Kopanick, his childhood friend and adult business associate, who was in the room to help me better understand Kilmer,
sentences.zh: 官方说法是，根据他的童年好友兼成年后的商业伙伴布拉德·科普尼克的说法，他在房间里帮助我更好地了解基默，

sentences.en: Hellmel's mission is to serve as a fun, sacred space where eclectic artists gather with novices to collaborate and, through new technology, inspire change and spark giving
sentences.zh: 海尔梅尔的宗旨是作为一个有趣、神圣的空间，让形形色色的艺术家与新手聚集在一起进行合作，并通过新技术激励变革，激发奉献精神

sentences.en: in our local, underserved community.
sentences.zh: 在我们当地服务不足的社区中。

sentences.en: Of its storefronts, one is a traditional art gallery.
sentences.zh: 在其店面中，一个是传统的艺术画廊。

sentences.en: Another is a dark window display with three black cubes that say God, stenciled in white paint, behind which is an inventory of merch from Kilmer's long and storied movie career,
sentences.zh: 另一个是暗色调的橱窗展示，里面有三个黑色的立方体，用白漆印着“上帝”字样，后面摆放着基默漫长而传奇的电影生涯中的周边库存，

sentences.en: socks that featured his tombstone character Doc Holliday and Jim Morrison coasters from his role in The Doors and some paintings that Kilmer himself created,
sentences.zh: 印有他饰演的墓碑镇角色多克·霍利迪的袜子，他在《大门乐队》中扮演的角色吉姆·莫里森的杯垫，以及基默自己创作的一些画作，

sentences.en: some of which are about his film career, a rendering of his Top Gun character Iceman with the word love stenciled across it and some that aren't, a hummingbird in a foreSt.
sentences.zh: 其中一些关于他的电影生涯，一幅《壮志凌云》角色冰人的画像，上面印着“爱”字，还有一些则不然，比如森林中的蜂鸟。

sentences.en: The final storefront is a door that leads to the Willy Wonka core of Hellmel.
sentences.zh: 最后一个店面是一扇门，通往海尔梅尔的威利·旺卡核心区。

sentences.en: Inside, there's a podcasting studio, a cafe area, and a screening room.
sentences.zh: 里面有一个播客工作室、一个咖啡区和一个放映室。

sentences.en: Hellmel also houses a foundation
sentences.zh: 海尔梅尔还设有由方和科普尼克创建的基金会，

sentences.en: Val and Copenic created called Twain Mania, which aims to send its Mark Twain curriculum into schools.
sentences.zh: 名为“马克·吐温狂热”，旨在将马克·吐温的课程引入学校。

sentences.en: Twice a week, high school students from South Central Los Angeles practice Hamlet and other plays there as part of a program called Inner City Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 每周两次，来自洛杉矶中南区的高中生在那里练习《哈姆雷特》和其他戏剧，作为名为“内城莎士比亚”项目的一部分。

sentences.en: Hellmel started holding events last February, a screening of Tombstone, an Echo in the Canyon concert.
sentences.zh: 海尔梅尔去年2月开始举办活动，包括放映《墓碑镇》，举办“峡谷回音”音乐会。

sentences.en: It is the creative incubator of Kilmer's dreams, the fruition of a vision he had always hoped his 6,000-acre New Mexico ranch would be
sentences.zh: 这是基默梦想的创意孵化器，是他一直希望自己位于新墨西哥州占地6000英亩的牧场能成为的样子的实现

sentences.en: before he lost most of it in the 2008 housing crash.
sentences.zh: 在他于2008年住房危机中失去大部分牧场之前。

sentences.en: The idea is to create kind of a life that's active,
sentences.zh: 这个想法是创造一种积极的生活，

sentences.en: Kilmer told me.
sentences.zh: 基默对我说。

sentences.en: It's active.
sentences.zh: 它是积极的。

sentences.en: It's alive.
sentences.zh: 它是活生生的。

sentences.en: I want the feel of it being alive.
sentences.zh: 我希望它充满生命力。

sentences.en: You feel the electricity.
sentences.zh: 你能感受到那种电荷。

sentences.en: He sat at his desk.
sentences.zh: 他坐在书桌旁。

sentences.en: Behind him was a replica of a painting he had sold to Robert Downey Jr., and on the other side, a maybe two-foot-tall Batman figure with a Mark Twain head.
sentences.zh: 他身后是一幅卖给小罗伯特·唐尼的画作的复制品，另一边是一个大约两英尺高的、顶着马克·吐温脑袋的蝙蝠侠雕像。

sentences.en: Elsewhere were Apple computers from the 1980s and 1990s dipped in glossy red paint, a tumbleweed bathed in gold paint.
sentences.zh: 其他地方摆放着浸过亮红漆的20世纪80和90年代的苹果电脑，以及浸过金漆的草滚球。

sentences.en: There was a box of newly shipped hardcovers of his new memoir,
sentences.zh: 有一箱刚运来的精装版新回忆录，

sentences.en: I'm Your Huckleberry, which debuted on the bestseller list in April, a brooding photo of the Val Kilmer of your 1990s matinee memories on its cover.
sentences.zh: 《我是你的随从》（I'm Your Huckleberry），它于4月登上畅销书排行榜，封面是你在90年代银幕记忆中那个沉思的方·基默的照片。

sentences.en: On the walls were more of his paintings, swishes of paint and resin and oil, and sometimes spray paint, on sheets of repurposed aluminum.
sentences.zh: 墙上挂着更多的画作，那是颜料、树脂、油画颜料，有时还有喷漆，在废旧铝板上的涂抹挥洒。

sentences.en: He makes them by swirling around the chemicals and paint until they look like an emotion or an element to him, at which point he adds a photograph,
sentences.zh: 他通过旋转化学品和颜料，直到它们在他眼中看起来像某种情绪或元素时才罢手，此时他会添加一张照片，

sentences.en: solidifying his theory into fact.
sentences.zh: 将他的理论固化为事实。
